name: Siphon
description: Bring Stremio catalogs, metadata, subtitles and stream versions to native Jellyfin libraries.

versions.changelog: Persistent private downloads with pause, priority, per-user quotas, UTC scheduling, batch preparation and explicit track selection; bounded playback admission and read snapshots; opt-in notification adapters and digests; translated administration and personal controls, aggregate local health, offline backup and restore, and verified assets-first publication. Saved-library restoration no longer blocks host startup. Search additions/removals publish only affected titles, recover missing preview artwork, preserve retained history and expose confirmed removal controls. A padded catalog image preserves the original logo. Finite HLS exports support validated video formats; audio-only/live HLS and unsupported DRM are rejected, and resumed HLS jobs restage rather than append.

Siphon 1.5.0.0: private user addon profiles, native collections and saved additions, selected-version HTTP/P2P downloads, source and metadata diagnostics, selective history recovery, followed-series calendar and opt-in notifications, targeted synchronization, provider quotas and shared caching, IntroDB timings, and bounded opt-in P2P playback. Includes media-response validation and the unchanged supplied icon. Persistent offline queues, offline HLS exports and external webhooks remain unreleased 1.6 features.
